paragraphs: If you demand the best for your group’s transportation, Deluxe Limousine Service has the premier Shuttle Van Service Anaheim residents and visitors trust. Whether relocating a large group for corporate functions and conventions, family events and weddings, or airport transportation, our shuttle vans are the safe, convenient, and reliable choice.

Our Anaheim shuttle vans comfortably move up to 15 passengers for conventions, weddings, family outings, and airport runs — with the same polished, professional service as our limousines. Weddings often add a [wedding party shuttle Orange County](/orange/wedding-party-shuttle/) to handle guest transfers between venues.

With flexible scheduling and experienced chauffeurs, our shuttle service is the smart alternative to coordinating multiple cars. For larger transfers around town, combine the shuttle with a [party bus rental near Anaheim](/anaheim/party-bus-rental/) for groups that want to travel together.
